blocks.text: Gamers, artists, cosplayers, aspiring developers, and industry professionals came together at SM Seaside City Cebu on September 12 and 13 for the Imaginators Convention (ICon) 2026, a two-day gathering that put Cebu’s emerging game development, animation, and creative technology communities in the spotlight. Organized by Cebu Institute of Technology – University (CIT-U) in partnership with the Game Developer Association of the Philippines (GDAP), ICon 2026 featured student-developed games, industry talks, interactive exhibits, cosplay competitions, and game booths throughout the Cube Wing. But beyond the games and activities, the convention offered students a look at an industry they could see themselves becoming […]...
